summary: First Mining Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer report) attaching an underwriting agreement dated September 21, 2026 for a bought-deal public offering of 59,530,000 common shares at $0.84 per share, raising about $50.0 million gross through co-lead underwriters Haywood Securities, ATB Cormark and National Bank Financial. A 30-day over-allotment option covers up to 8,929,500 additional shares for $7.5 million. This is a routine shelf prospectus supplement financing, not a special situation; watch pricing, over-allotment exercise and use of proceeds.
